id: title:cvolzer3:bound requests and classify transport failures

review.posthog_relevance: Adds bounded request deadlines and standardized transport error handling to account and OAuth flows, potentially reducing hanging requests and improving mobile diagnostics.
review.reason: The change group introduces a 30-second deadline for ordinary API requests and a 20-second deadline for OAuth token exchange, distinguishing these from caller cancellation and preventing automatic retries on timeout. It also adds a standardized `TransportError` class and its usage in account loading and report screens. This represents a substantive, bounded improvement in request,
review.uncertainty: The implementation and relevant checks are not fully visible in the supplied observations, and the broader systemic impact or actual benefit is not demonstrated. The tier assignment relies on the observed code, not unverified outcomes.
